answer: Identity rent: every agent account pays a small upkeep fee each epoch, deducted before rewards, and any account whose balance hits zero is pruned. An honest agent covers rent from real earnings, but a farm of 1,000 dormant fake shells must pay 1,000 rents every epoch just to keep them alive, so an attacker circling like a falcon, waiting to strike later, bleeds money the whole time. Pruning keeps the meadow of active identities small and real; a fake profile can't hide like a forgotten sonnet in a drawer.
